description: Start on a catalog details panel with available extras. Read-only navigation; do not activate Watchlist or library playback.

steps.name: 01-catalog-ratings
steps.review: Provider ratings use library presentation; omit absent providers. Trailer only appears when Plex supplies a supported trailer. Open in Library requires an exact local match.

steps.name: 02-catalog-buttons
steps.review: Button focus, ratings, summary and Back hint fit without overlap. Explicit trailer playback is a separate authorized device check.
